propositions: Three diagnostic artifact files exist on commit 556708771e but are not ancestors of origin/main, making ticket evidence unverifiable on main.

Diagnostic artifacts (transcript findings, parameterized driver scripts, and budget-anchoring matrix) are reusable and follow established docs/experiments/ convention, warranting landing on main unchanged.
Artifacts depend only on stable surfaces (pai_tools and _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS) and produce no committed raw transcripts, making them durable and re-runnable.
Landing the three artifact files separately from the 2948 implementation commit ensures evidence is independently verifiable on main without dragging unrelated implementation changes.
